messages:
oliver.f: Hey team, Vendor 'Maple Metrics' submitted invoice MM-310 for $15,450 but invoice lacks PO and vendor name shows 'MapleMetrics Co.' PDF: https://files.redwood/maple/MM-310.pdf

nina-finops: AP auto-match failed. Our vendor file is MAPLE METRICS LLC. Also invoice has 'billing contact' as unknown.

sara.proc: I can create a PO fast. Creating PO draft 6999 assigned to @head-ops, marked urgent. Link: https://proc.redwood/purchase/6999

oliver.f: We need this paid this week for model training credits. Can procurement also confirm GL code? Use 6008 (ML tooling).

nina-finops: AP policy: over $10k requires PO or finance exec approval. Approvals-bot, place hold and note vendor name mismatch.

ap-bot: Hold placed on invoice MM-310 by nina-finops at 2026-10-05 09:02 UTC. Reason: missing PO and vendor name mismatch. Suggested: vendor reissue with PO or procurement link.

sara.proc: PO 6999 approved by head-ops at 10:15. I updated vendor note to MAPLE METRICS LLC and set bill-to to ml-platform@redwood.

oliver.f: Told vendor to reissue with PO 6999. They uploaded corrected invoice MM-310-PO6999.pdf at 10:25.

nina-finops: AP matched invoice to PO 6999 and scheduled for payment run. GL mapped to 6008 per request. Removing hold. Closing loop.

oliver.f: Thanks all. Please ping when payment posts so we can allocate credits.
